workbench.intent: Repeated operational work with scan-friendly data and restrained decoration.
avoid_for: Long editorial reading without adjusting type and measure
Expressive brand storytelling as the only direction
workbench.color: Low-chroma neutral canvas/surfaces; existing brand accent for actions and selection; status colors only for real meaning. A cool neutral plus blue is one starting direction when no brand exists, not an industry rule.
workbench.font: Preserve the app font. For a new product use a tested system sans or an already integrated Inter/Geist; tabular numerals for comparable values.
workbench.density: Compact for the work area; comfortable for editing. Desktop page padding 16–24px and group gaps 12–16px are starting points, not overrides of control internals.
workbench.geometry: Clear alignment, restrained radii, light boundaries; shadows express overlays/elevation rather than every region.
workbench.media_motion: Icons aid recognition; avoid decorative imagery and staggered data-row animation.
checks: Task area dominates chrome
Dense rows remain readable and operable
Long Vietnamese labels and values fit
Primary actions and statuses remain distinct

calm-business.intent: Approachable professional UI with clear hierarchy and moderate spacing.
avoid_for: Treating every region as an elevated card
Using spacious marketing density inside dense tables
calm-business.color: Quiet neutral background, readable surfaces and one main brand accent. Inherit an existing palette; keep supporting decoration lower emphasis than actions.
calm-business.font: One readable sans family for body and controls; a distinct heading family is optional only for a real brand role.
calm-business.density: Comfortable: desktop page padding 24–32px, mobile around 16px, group gaps 16–24px; marketing sections may be wider-spaced.
calm-business.geometry: Consistent control/card/overlay radius roles. Inset workspace is an option when it clarifies the canvas; flat sections need no card.
calm-business.media_motion: Product/service evidence may support marketing; application screens use imagery sparingly. Preserve native component motion.
checks: Page title, sections and controls have distinct emphasis
No repeated decorative cards
Primary action is clear within its group
Form and mobile reading order are coherent

editorial.intent: Sustained reading with a deliberate editorial tone.
avoid_for: Serif/display styling imposed on all dense control labels
Multiple sidebars squeezing the reading column
editorial.color: Neutral or gently warm canvas with strong text contrast; accent used sparingly for navigation/actions. Warm neutral plus terracotta is an optional direction, not a prevalidated palette.
editorial.font: Preserve existing typography. A serif such as Source Serif 4 is a candidate for prose/headings; use readable sans for controls. Verify actual font files, language coverage, license and fallback before adoption.
editorial.density: Start with 60–75ch reading measure and body line-height about 1.6–1.75; adjust to actual typeface/language. Use spacing between sections instead of boxing paragraphs.
editorial.geometry: Editorial rhythm and alignment; modest borders where information changes type; little elevation.
editorial.media_motion: Images, figures and pull quotes must add content. Motion must not interfere with reading or anchor navigation.
checks: Long reading is comfortable
Semantic headings match structure
Code/tables do not break reflow
Diacritics and text-spacing changes remain readable

product-led.intent: Let products or selected work supply visual identity and evidence.
avoid_for: Media overwhelming price, identity or decision information
product-led.color: A neutral canvas that supports the actual media, with brand accent reserved for useful emphasis. Avoid using status color as sales decoration.
product-led.font: Readable names, descriptions and prices; expressive headings may carry brand identity while controls stay clear.
product-led.density: Consistent grid gaps and media ratios; choose minimum card width from real content rather than forcing a column count.
product-led.geometry: Stable image proportions, controlled crops, consistent action placement; border/card treatment only where grouping helps.
product-led.media_motion: Use real supplied assets with useful alternatives. Reserve space before load; all hover-revealed actions need a touch/keyboard path.
checks: Product/project identity and next step are clear
Long names and prices fit
Media fallback and loading do not collapse layout
Evidence and claims are real

technical.intent: Precise information architecture for developer tools, monitoring or technical docs.
avoid_for: Monospace for every paragraph and control
Dark-only styling inferred from the product category
technical.color: Restrained neutral surfaces with distinguishable selection and data-series roles. Support the app's actual theme policy; do not assume dark mode only.
technical.font: Sans for UI and prose, mono for code/IDs. Existing Geist Mono or an intentionally adopted IBM Plex Sans/Mono pair are candidates; verify actual loading and glyph coverage.
technical.density: Task-dependent: compact for monitoring, readable measure for documentation. Keep code/table overflow local.
technical.geometry: Aligned grids, clear boundaries and restrained elevation; keep status meaning distinct from brand styling.
technical.media_motion: Diagrams and charts explain systems/data; avoid decorative particle effects or motion behind text.
checks: Code and identifiers distinguish ambiguous characters
Chart states and units are clear
Long logs/commands remain accessible
Navigation and content hierarchy match the task
